user.title: Atios SmartCore (expert)
user.description: This sets up direct raw-DALI access to the SmartCore. For everyday light control, most users should instead pair the SmartCore via Matter (DALI Configurator → Accessory Manager → Matter). Enter the SmartCore IP address or hostname.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SmartCore at that address.

init.title: Atios SmartCore options
init.description: The sidebar panel embeds the SmartCore web interface inside Home Assistant. Note: an http:// panel URL will not embed inside an https:// Home Assistant, and the SmartCore must not send X-Frame-Options: DENY.

data.panel_enabled: Show the SmartCore web interface in the sidebar
data.panel_require_admin: Only show the panel to admin users
